_comment: Maps the uploaded input to a pre-made export .xlsx in this folder. The key is matched (separator-insensitive: 'bom1' matches 'BOM_1.xls', 'BOM 1.xlsx', 'BOM-1') against the uploaded file name, then the sheet name. First match wins. Add bom3 / bom5 here when their import files are dropped in.
_no_preview_comment: Keys listed here still DOWNLOAD their golden sheet, but the Export BOM tree preview is suppressed (frontend shows 'no preview available'). Remove a key from this list once its preview is ready.
